method: Built-in image_gen identity-preserving charcoal cutout and ivory recolor; unchanged source PNGs feed an explicitly authorized whole-frame atlas bake. Blank source faces receive complete rendered eyes/smile in the derived frames. Selected and unused prompts are in ghost-prompts.json.
renderer: Runtime predecoded complete-frame lossless WebP atlas playback in permanent per-avatar Canvas2D views, no runtime WebGL/mesh load. Eight columns by seven rows: frames0..48 wave over2.1s, frames49..55 blink over320ms; about24fps only while changing frames,8400ms idle blink wait. Below100px uses96px frames, otherwise256px. Complete first-frame CSS fallback while loading or decode failure. Fixed button hitbox, artwork pointer-events:none; ignore active greeting and2800ms cooldown. User-approved whole-artwork vertical drift +/-2px, preview +/-4px,5.6s; separate fixed shadow. Reduced motion, remembered pause, document/intersection visibility stop motion.
scope: Private Steward Web presentation; no execution or model status contract.
tooling: Unchanged ImageGen source PNGs feed tools/bake.html + tools/ghost-bake-mesh.js + tools/bake-server.py, served once on127.0.0.1:8789, which bake complete PNG frame atlases. tools/encode-frames.py invokes installed cwebp -lossless -exact -m 6, writes lossless WebP atlases, then removes intermediate baked PNGs. Continuous96x96 2D mesh, anchored shoulder(.75,.54), maximum.18rad wave envelope are build-only. dist/ghost-mesh.js is removed; no runtime WebGL or3D model. No measured GPU savings claim is made.
